MASTER CALENDAR JURY
Off Calendar Jun-26-2006 Assigned To Trial Court

COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Jun-26-2006 Vacated
MINI MINUTES: This matter came regularly on calendar this day, by assignment from the Department of the Presiding Judge for Settlement on the Record.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Beldon Yee.
Patricia Fyfe, Esq. for Plaintiff: Pete Chilicas, also present.
Jason Wolford, Esq. for Defendant: Theresa Sandoval, also prensent.
Parties have settled, terms read into the record as follows:
Judgment Pursuant to Stipulation, for restitution and possession of the property located at 451 Leland Ave., San Francisco. Rental agreement forfeited, Writ issued, Judgment is stayed 'til 5:00 P.M.Aug. 31, 2006. If Defendant vacated, plaintiff waives back-rent of $7,695.00 and damages to property. Any personal property left is deemed abandoned and to be disposed of by the Plaintiff. Parties waives any claim against the other, but Not on Defendant's P.I. action in case #452582. Each to bear own fees and costs. No other person claim the right to possession. Defendant shall signed the stipulated agreement within five days when present with the doc.
Parties agreed to terms, matter is deemed settled, trial vacated.
